title: Onewheel Range by Tire-Pressure Band
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ride:session platform="onewheel" tire_psi_band=* range_miles=*
| stats avg(range_miles) as avg_range_miles, count as events by tire_psi_band
| sort - avg_range_miles
description: Shows average range miles by tire-pressure band for Onewheel rides.
value: Average range miles by tire-pressure band helps compare Onewheel rides across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `range_miles` on `ride:session` events and normalize `tire_psi_band` so Splunk can summarize performance by tire-pressure band.
visualization: Bar chart of average range miles by tire-pressure band.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the average range miles for each tire-pressure band so you can see what works best for Onewheel rides.
